_notes.source: Live https://www.tradeday.com/ pricing cards read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 - list and code prices unchanged from 2026-10-03; Google Maps. Earlier sources listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: All prices USD per MONTH (billing = monthly). standard = the crossed-out list price on the pricing card. promo = null on purpose: the page shows a 55% lower price with code TDNEW (e.g. 25K $45 instead of $100) but does not say whether the discount covers only the first month or every renewal, so showing it could mislead. Discounted prices seen 2026-10-03 (Quick Pay Intraday / Quick Pay EOD / Fast Pass): 25K $45 / $54 / $59, 50K $59 / $79 / $85, 100K $108 / $129 / $149, 150K $162 / $180 / $225. Add them back once TradeDay confirms the discount applies to every month (or label them first-month only). Prices are the same for Tradovate and Rithmic. Re-checked 2026-10-20: TDNEW still shown (cards 55% off, banner 'up to 55%/60% off'); the page still does not say whether it covers renewals, so promo stays null.
_notes.billing: Monthly subscription: the first payment is taken at sign-up and recurs every 30 days until you pass or cancel; no time limit to pass. No activation fee on any plan. Resets are extra (help centre, Quick Pay Intraday / Quick Pay EOD / Fast Pass): 25K $45 / $54 / $59, 50K $60 / $85 / $85, 100K $110 / $135 / $140, 150K $165 / $195 / $225. The pricing cards show slightly lower reset prices for some sizes (e.g. 50K Quick Pay Intraday $59, 100K $108), probably the discounted figure.
_notes.rules_detail: Quick Pay: profit target, trailing max drawdown calculated intraday (or end-of-day during the evaluation on the EOD version - the funded account is always intraday), 30% consistency and min 5 trading days in the evaluation. Funded Sim: no consistency rule, no payout buffer, payouts from day 1, minimum request $250. Fast Pass: end-of-day trailing drawdown in evaluation and funded, 45% consistency in evaluation and funded, min 3 trading days to pass (the FAQ also describes it as 'no minimum trading day requirement'; the card says 3); funded payouts need 5 profitable days of $100 / $150 / $200 / $250, minimum request $250, maximum per cycle $750 / $1,500 / $1,875 / $2,250; funded position limit starts at 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 contracts and scales +1 per $2K profit. No daily loss limit is listed on any card (daily_loss = null, not stated). Trailing drawdown stops at the starting balance.
_notes.profit_split: Quick Pay Funded Sim: 50/50 on net profit below $4K, 80/20 above $4K; 90/10 in Funded Live. Fast Pass: 80/20 in Funded Sim, 90/10 in Funded Live. profit_split_max = 80 (the Funded Sim split, before moving live).
_notes.fee_refund: Footer: 'All subscription fees are non-refundable except where required by law.' fee_refund = false.
_notes.platforms: Help centre: CQG (Tradovate) - Tradovate, NinjaTrader (free NT8), TradingView and Jigsaw (own licence needed). Rithmic - R|Trader Pro, Quantower, ATAS, MotiveWave, Bookmap, Jigsaw, Sierra Chart, EdgeProX, Finamark, Volfix, WealthCharts, MultiCharts, Overcharts. NinjaTrader Desktop is not supported with Rithmic accounts.
_notes.company: TradeDay LLC, Chicago, Illinois 60607 (site footer). 'Established 2020' / 'Since 2020' on the homepage and about page; founders' backgrounds include running Chicago futures trading firms. Terms governed by Illinois law. Not related to any firm already listed.
_notes.affiliate_program: Has a program (https://www.tradeday.com/affiliate-program, sign-up form https://tradeday.postaffiliatepro.com/affiliates/signup.php#SignupForm, runs on Post Affiliate Pro). Commission tiered by monthly sales: $0-$5,000 = 15%, $5,001-$10,000 = 20%, $10,001+ = 22.5% 'on all purchases'. Higher tiers also get graphics, newsletter features, giveaways and a free $50K evaluation. 'New Partners Apply' - applications are reviewed. Payout method, minimum payout and cookie length: not stated on the public page. Comparison sites / UAE-based affiliates: not mentioned (the UAE is not on the trader prohibited list).
_notes.marketing_stats_excluded: The site publishes a 36% pass rate (Jan-Jun 2026) and payout totals; not reproduced here (directory policy).
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official TradeDay page.
_notes.google_rating: Google Maps (2026-10-20): 'TradeDay', financial institution, TradeDay LLC, 2nd Floor, 412 S Wells St, Chicago, IL 60607 (website tradeday.com) - 4.8 from 1,035 reviews.

firm.name: TradeDay
firm.about: TradeDay is a Chicago-based futures prop firm, running since 2020, that sells monthly evaluations in two styles: Quick Pay, with payouts from the first funded day, and Fast Pass, which has a 3-trading-day minimum before you can pass. Account sizes run from $25K to $150K.

countries.notes: Set by TradeDay's US clearing firm and broker. Applies to citizens OR residents of these countries, and to people trading mainly from them while visiting. Also listed: the Crimea region of Ukraine, 'Balkans' and people on the 'Magnitsky' sanctions list (no single country code). Kosovo is recorded as XK (a widely used code, not an official ISO one). German citizens and Canadians outside Ontario can trade Funded Sim only, not Funded Live. Funded traders must pass KYC/AML checks with ID and proof of address. The UAE and the US are not on the list.

trustpilot_quotes.quote: Great firm with straight forward rules and reliable payouts. They have a clear path to funded and are there to help you throughout your trading journey.

trustpilot_quotes.quote: Seem okay. Support is quick and friendly so that is good. The trade fees (commission + etc) are literally double all other leading prop firms so that is bad.
